service_path: NASA CLPS CT-4 / Intuitive Machines IM-5

responsibilities.nasa: CLPS service buyer and MNP sensor owner
responsibilities.intuitive_machines: End-to-end lunar delivery, lander and stated network/data service; Rover-specific interfaces and service levels unqualified
responsibilities.elo2: Rover development and remote surface operation from Australia

sources.supports: Roo-ver manifested on CLPS delivery; NASA selects Intuitive Machines for end-to-end surface delivery to South Pole region targeted 2030; all rovers/instruments collectively about 75 kg; Agency is Roo-ver lead
Nova-D planned for IM-5; target Mons Malapert; lander and network/data service; MNP integrated with Roo-ver
IM-5 initial targeted launch mid-year 2030, not an allocated departure window
Agency presentation: Roo-ver approximately 20 kg, integrated NASA payload, expected 14 days surface operations, operated from Australian centre
Agency describes Roo-ver at around 20 kilograms and expected to operate for up to 14 Earth days; this is a planned mission envelope, not a certified physical limit
ELO2 designs, builds and operates Roo-ver in partnership with the Agency; government funds rover development and operation
